bias.en: Downtrend · SAR flipped bearish, at the Nov 6 low
bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 抛物线 SAR 转为看空，位于 11月6日低点

read.en: AAOI fell 9.5% on Nov 16 to $45.16, trading $44.78–47.88. It is below the 5-day ($50.4), 10-day ($52.4), 30-day ($74.9), 100-day ($102.1) and 200-day ($115.0); all but the 200-day are falling. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13, below zero, histogram widening again; Parabolic SAR flipped bearish on Nov 16 ($57.94), and RSI is 32.0.
read.zh: AAOI 11月16日下跌 9.5%，收于 $45.16，盘中区间 $44.78–47.88。股价位于 5 日（$50.4）、10 日（$52.4）、30 日（$74.9）、100 日（$102.1）和 200 日均线（$115.0）下方；除 200 日均线外均在下行。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图再度放大；抛物线 SAR 于 11月16日转为看空（$57.94），RSI 为 32.0。

read.en: The drop broke the $45.4–47.3 supports (Nov 10 and 13 lows, the old SAR), now resistance, and the $44.78 low undercut the Nov 6 low ($45.15). Resistance is $46.4–47.9, then $50.4–50.8 (5-day, Nov 12 low) and $52.4–53.5 (10-day, Nov 13 high). Support is $44.8–45.2, then $40–41.4. A close above $47.9 would target $50.4–50.8; below $44.8, $40–41.4.

r.en: Nov 10 low $46.39 and Nov 13 low $47.28, lost; Nov 16 high $47.88
